newsitem.title: GERMANY: German pay TV channel Premiere on AOL.
newsitem.headline: German pay TV channel Premiere on AOL.

text.p: Germany's leading pay television channel Premiere said on Thursday it would launch a series of electronic magazines on AOL, the online service joint venture between Bertelsmann AG and America Online.

Beginning on Friday, Premiere's foray into the online world will combine information about its pay television programme as well as online publications and features such as "chat rooms", where users exchange messages by electronic mail.

Premiere will open six areas -- interactive magazines that subscribers to the online service can access -- on AOL that focus on movies, sports, offbeat issues and erotic themes and would also put its electronic programme guide online.
The movie section will provide information about films, cinema trivia and games, while sports will host popular athletes and a ticket service for special sports events.
The erotic area would be "as open and fresh as possible", the company said in a statement, with features such as the "cabinet of moans", "Hot Shots", and the "Erotic Screenplay".
